basic_info.description: This beautifully remodeled single-family mid-century home in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood blends timeless design with modern comfort. The living room captures sweeping west-facing views, adding a dramatic backdrop to everyday living. The open plan eat-in kitchen features a full stainless steel appliance package and a skylight, creating a bright and welcoming space. With three bedrooms and two bathrooms including a primary suite with an attached bath, the home showcases stylish updates throughout, including newly remodeled kitchen and baths, new wooden floors, and recessed lighting. Step outside to a mature backyard with a sunny patio and vibrant plantings, an ideal setting for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the city's mild climate. The generous garage with interior access offers ample storage space and may accommodate two smaller cars, while also housing a laundry area with washer and dryer hookups for added convenience. Located near McLaren Park and offering easy freeway access, this move-in ready gem provides a peaceful retreat with quick connections to the energy of The City.
